bugs_found: apply_fee computes fee as pct * pct instead of amount * fee_pct, causing systematically wrong fees and potentially over/undercharging
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failure while updating account_to.balance can leave balances inconsistent
transfer only rejects object identity self-transfers, allowing two Account objects with the same id to transfer to itself
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, allowing type errors or precision/type inconsistencies with Decimal balances
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing behavior for fractional inputs without validation
fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates because only amount is validated, enabling invalid conversions
